ana (eng-sre): FYI: SLO corridor compression will be applied Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. This reduces p99 buffer from +150ms to +75ms for 'generate' and 'chat' routes. Aim: tighten latency SLOs before next weeks release. runbook: https://rwd.internal/runbooks/slo-corridor-compression
tom (oncall): noted. will be primary on the bridge. any expected user impact?
ana (typo)
ana (eng-sre): sorry typo above. expect transient rebalancing; natively we don't expect errors. If p99 breach > 2x baseline for 5m, we'll revert corridor.
jess (product): will this change affect canaries? should we pause new canary rollouts during the window?
ana (eng-sre): yes please pause new canaries for 6h around the window. existing canaries run but watch for regressions.
infra-bot: maintenance notice created: Sat 2026-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Alerts scheduled 24h/1h prior.
tom (oncall): adding dashboard widgets: p99 latency, p50, error-rate, canary-health. will page on p99 > threshold.
ana (eng-sre): abbrev runbook excerpt for leadership: "purpose: compress SLO corridors to reflect improved infra determinism. scope: hosted API. risk: low; brief p99 oscillation possible. rollback: reapply previous corridor config."
jess (product): noted. i'll add a line to release notes about temporary SLO tuning.
tom (oncall): ack 60; i'll be on the bridge and will mute noisy alerts until paging thresholds hit.
